summary: Lion Copper Corp. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) announcing Nasdaq approval to list its common shares on the Nasdaq Capital Market under symbol 'LCU', expected to begin trading at market open Monday, October 19, 2026, subject to customary listing conditions. Shares continue trading on the Canadian Securities Exchange under 'LCU'; OTCQB quotation under 'LCGMF' is expected to cease upon Nasdaq commencement. No shareholder action is required. The release cites progress on the Yerington Copper Project in Nevada, with CEO John Banning quoted. This is a routine uplisting, not a special situation; watch for trading liquidity migration.
